title: I Will Pour Out My Spirit
editorialNotes: Full anchors to assembly arc (vv12-23): trumpet, gathering, priests between porch and altar, divine pity hinge (v18), restoration promise. Outpouring oracle (vv28-32) stays Short-only — per feedback_split_mixed_tone_passages, growing Long would force choosing between assembly-arc and Pentecost-shaped outpouring.
reflectionText: Joel called for the trumpet to be sounded, the fast to be sanctified, the priests to weep between the porch and the altar. The Lord answered: I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. What is it to be told that the answer to your assembly's grief is a Spirit that has not yet been poured out at all?
